business.description: Thirumalai Chemicals Limited is a globally integrated specialty chemicals group manufacturing Phthalic Anhydride, Maleic Anhydride, Malic Acid, Fumaric Acid, and Diethyl Phthalate. The company operates manufacturing facilities in India (Ranipet, Dahej), Malaysia, and the United States, serving customers across food, pharmaceutical, paints, resins, and specialty chemical industries.

products.name: Phthalic Anhydride (PA)
products.note: Key raw material: O-Xylene. Manufacturing locations: Ranipet, Dahej. Applications: Plasticisers, pigments, dyes, Unsaturated Polyester Resins (UPR), herbicides, fire retardants. Among top 3 global producers, largest in India.

products.name: Maleic Anhydride (MAN)
products.note: Manufacturing locations: Malaysia (OOSB), USA (TCL Specialties LLC - under construction). Applications: Downstream for Malic Acid, Fumaric Acid, polyester resins, alkyd resins, printing inks, pharmaceuticals (API), agricultural chemicals. Largest producer in Southeast Asia.

products.name: Malic Acid
products.note: Key raw material: Maleic Anhydride. Manufacturing location: Ranipet. Applications: Food, beverages, confectionery, skincare, pharmaceuticals, animal feed, metal cleaning, textile dyeing, paint formulations. One of few Indian facilities producing both food-grade and pharma-grade.

products.name: Fumaric Acid
products.note: Key raw material: Maleic Anhydride. Manufacturing location: Ranipet. Applications: Food, bakery, tortillas, animal feed, bath salts, polyester resins, inks, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals. Largest producer in India.

products.name: Diethyl Phthalate (DEP)
products.note: Key raw materials: Ethanol, Phthalic Anhydride. Manufacturing location: Ranipet. Applications: Perfumes, cosmetics, insect repellents, plasticiser for medical packaging, adhesives, insecticide formulations. Primary use as solvent in fragrances.

outlook.statement: Focus on improving EBITDA through higher volumes and better realisations, maintain tight control over working capital and operating cash flows to reduce debt and finance costs. Priorities: maximise capacity utilisation, maintain cost leadership, deliver consistent quality. Expect improved operating leverage, stronger cash generation and gradual deleveraging as Dahej reaches full contribution and US project progresses.

Some uncertainties (geopolitical, trade policies, tariff barriers, supply chain disruptions) expected to persist, requiring continued vigilance and adaptability in managing procurement, production and customer commitments.

India continues to offer compelling long-term growth opportunities driven by structural growth drivers and expanding consumption base in construction, infrastructure, food, pharmaceuticals and consumer applications.
Committed to 2030 sustainability goals: 25% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions, 10% reduction in water consumption, 10% reduction in industrial waste from FY 2022-23 baseline.
The Company expects an improvement in performance as market conditions improve and projects achieve full operational capacity.
Productivity and profitability are expected to improve in the coming years as projects reach optimal capacity utilisation and market conditions strengthen.

India's growth outlook remains favourable, supported by export diversification, manufacturing expansion, resilient services activity, and stronger bilateral trade partnerships. GDP growth is projected at around 6.4% in FY 2026-27.
Market conditions have stabilized, enabling recovery in operating margins. Maximizing capacity utilization remains primary strategic objective for current fiscal year.
Expanded Dahej facility expected to operate at higher utilization levels, enabling better leverage of investments and stronger presence in export markets.
US subsidiary projected to achieve operational stabilization and growth in FY2027, capturing market share as American customers prioritize secure domestic sourcing.
Global chemical demand projected to grow from USD 5.56 billion in 2026 to USD 7.31 billion by 2034 (CAGR 3.5%). Phthalic anhydride market projected to sustain 4-5% growth trajectory.
Indian chemical industry domestic demand expected to nearly triple to US$1 trillion by 2040. India-UK FTA (effective July 2026) expected to benefit chemicals sector.
DEP global market size valued at ~USD 2.23 billion in 2025, projected to reach ~USD 3.42 billion by 2033 (CAGR 5.5%).

Company's objectives, expectations or forecasts may be forward-looking within the meaning of applicable securities laws and regulations. Actual results may differ materially from those expressed in the statement. Important factors that could influence the Company's operations include global and domestic demand and supply conditions affecting selling prices of finished goods, input availability and prices, changes in government regulations, tax laws, economic developments within the country and other factors such as litigation, plant breakdowns, industrial relations, etc.

Focused on advancing ESG ambitions, including further reduction of GHG emissions, enhancement of energy efficiency, responsible resource management, and evaluation of renewable energy integration opportunities.

Company continues to undertake projects aimed at reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions as part of its ongoing sustainability commitment. Actively evaluating feasibility of integrating renewable energy solutions and other low-carbon energy alternatives to further reduce carbon footprint.
As at 31 March 2026, the Company is uncertain about its ability to meet the specified loan covenants as at 30 September 2026 and 31 March 2027, due to anticipated challenges in the operations.
